references.text: Here parallels are drawn to leaving what is behind in order to follow God's call, which resembles Jesus' invitation to follow him and let the dead bury their own dead.
Luke gives a similar account where Jesus asks another person to follow him and not turn back to attend to family duties, emphasizing the importance of prioritizing Jesus' call.
This verse speaks about leaving the old to embrace the new in Christ, which resonates with Jesus' message to leave the dead behind in order to follow him.
